product_one_liner.value: Aurora Solar provides software for solar installers and sales teams to design, sell, and permit solar projects.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage says solar organizations, ranging from small sales teams to national dealers, use Aurora to design, sell, and permit solar: https://aurorasolar.com/.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists paid plans, including Basic with a monthly per-user price: https://www.aurorasolar.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Aurora publishes customer case studies identifying CertainTeed and Solaris Renewables and describing their use of Aurora software: https://resources.aurorasolar.com/certainteed-case-study and https://resources.aurorasolar.com/solaris-case-study. | named_customers.0: The CertainTeed customer case study describes choosing Aurora and using its software and services: https://resources.aurorasolar.com/certainteed-case-study. | named_customers.1: The Solaris Renewables case study describes Aurora delivering software for its design, sales, engineering, and installation needs: https://resources.aurorasolar.com/solaris-case-study.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 302 employees, placing it in the requested 201–500 band. Profile counts may not equal payroll headcount: https://linkedin.com/company/aurora-solar.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Aurora's own announcement explicitly states that the company is headquartered in San Francisco: https://aurorasolar.com/news/aurora-solar-adds-integrated-storage-modeling-to-helioscope-uniting-commercial-solar-design-storage-and-financial-analysis-in-one-solution. | hq_country: The company profile identifies its location country as United States and city as San Francisco: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about.

founded_year.notes: Aurora's company history explicitly dates its founding to August 2013: https://www.aurorasolar.com/about.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts were found within the broader company blog: an inference-pipeline optimization article by Senior Computer Vision Engineer Adriel Luo, and an AutoDesigner-team article explaining its mathematical optimization and genetic algorithms, with quantitative engineers identified. Sources: https://aurorasolar.com/blog/ai-helped-speed-up-our-ai and https://aurorasolar.com/blog/can-software-tell-us-the-optimal-solar-design.

public_docs.notes: Aurora has a public developer portal with tutorials, API reference material, and documentation for Sync API, Design API, and webhooks: https://docs.aurorasolar.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers board lists ten openings covering software computation, FP&A, business systems, analytics engineering, and account executives. None has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title; Staff Analytics Engineer is explicitly excluded by the question: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aurorasolar.

model_provider.notes: Aurora publicly lists Anthropic and OpenAI as AI-service subprocessors. This establishes provider relationships, not which specific models power each product feature: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/subprocessors.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust center names SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS–SAQ A 4.0, and GDPR. Only the requested categories are included: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/compliance. | compliance_certs.0: The certifications page names SOC 2 Type 2: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/certifications. | compliance_certs.1: The certifications page names PCI DSS–SAQ A 4.0: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/certifications. | compliance_certs.2: The certifications page publicly lists GDPR: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/certifications.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile explicitly identifies the latest funding round as Series D: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about. | funding_date: The latest-round profile gives February 28, 2022, matching the dated Series D announcement; the requested month format is 2022-02. Sources: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/climate-tech-saas-leader-aurora-solar-secures-200-million-in-series-d-to-further-the-digital-transformation-of-the-solar-ecosystem-301491593.html. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies the latest round amount as USD 200,000,000: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is the February 2022 Series D, before the May 2025 start of the requested 18-month window. Sources: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/climate-tech-saas-leader-aurora-solar-secures-200-million-in-series-d-to-further-the-digital-transformation-of-the-solar-ecosystem-301491593.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board lists a Mid-Market Account Executive opening with a live application link: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aurorasolar/cc3cf270-c536-4856-ae38-53a26fc0e3d8.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 22, 2026 announcement falls inside the six-month window and describes substantive launches, including live heat-pump modeling for eligible German installers: https://aurorasolar.com/news/aurora-solar-expands-beyond-solar.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Melanie Davis Chapman's profile dates her start as VP, Marketing to May 2026, within the 12-month window. This is an internal promotion into a VP role, not a newly verified external company hire: https://linkedin.com/in/melaniedavischapman.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Director, Business Systems posting explicitly names Salesforce and HubSpot: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aurorasolar/dfd4da2f-e07a-48d4-8bbf-7ee76cc42b60. | crm_stack_signal.0: The business-systems job posting names Salesforce Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aurorasolar/dfd4da2f-e07a-48d4-8bbf-7ee76cc42b60. | crm_stack_signal.1: The same business-systems posting names HubSpot: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aurorasolar/dfd4da2f-e07a-48d4-8bbf-7ee76cc42b60.
